summary: The construction and all claimed evaluations are correct. The rational affine inequalities give full-dimensional compact convex bodies with the stated complete integer support and original weights. Every positive barycentric support at an integer target is confined to its marker group. The two source-capacity bounds and the matching disjoint pairs plus central singleton prove the exact unrestricted packing value at every target, including endpoints and zero capacities. The layer maxima integrate to (m+1)/2, while the original all-target maximum equals 1; hence the gluing ratio is exactly 2/(m+1), with failure of the half-gluing inequality precisely for the asserted m>=4 instances and no positive universal factor. The logarithmic gaps, separate integral hitting values, closed halfspaces, and final normalization are consistent with the supplied accepted conventions. The m=1 case and threshold equality cases introduce no exception.
